title: What $1 Billion Actually Looks Like
lines: This is ten thousand dollars in hundred-dollar bills. | About one centimeter thick.
A million dollars weighs ten kilos, and fits in a briefcase.
A hundred million fills an entire shipping pallet.
A billion dollars? | Ten pallets. Ten tonnes of cash.
The world's richest people own hundreds of these.
And a trillion dollars? | Ten thousand pallets.
Stacked two high, they cover a whole football field.
